correctness.rationale: In the path-basis quotient modulo length three, all products involving a length-two path vanish, and [a,b] at basis path ef is α_eβ_f−β_eα_f. Distinct ordered paths are independent even with parallel arrows and both compositional orientations. For α support S, a graph edge between two supported vertices forces β_e/α_e=β_f/α_f, one freedom per induced component; any neighbor outside S has β=0, and vertices outside N[S] are unrestricted. Thus centralizer arrow dimension c(S)+m−|N[S]|, plus all p central length-two coefficients; the rank formula and weighted polynomial follow. For ordered pair counts, each nonzero pair vector (α_e,β_e) on a component occupies one of q+1 projective lines, with q−1 choices per vertex; count gives commuting probability. Transfer matrix for 0 and q+1 nonzero colors has path characteristic x²−qx−q(q−1); cyclic trace has a q-dimensional color-difference eigenspace q−1 and roots λ±. Boundary m=0, singleton arrows and self-compositions correctly contribute no graph loops. Independent direct finite-field commutator row-reduction verified 166 arrow assignments in varied path, cycle, loop and parallel-arrow examples; it is not an infinite proof.
residual_risks: Only centralizers inside J, not the whole unital A; requires truncation at R³, and finite checker uses prime fields.
